cover.desc: Full color, muted and low-key — the quietest cover of the run so far. A near-floor-level view of the end of the bandai counter at Kotobuki-yu: worn honey-coloured floorboards, the dark wood base of the counter, one warm lamp somewhere above and out of frame throwing a soft pool of light. Centre frame, squared up neatly against the counter with about a hand's width between them, a pair of worn blue rubber sandals — clearly a man's, clearly several sizes too large for anyone currently in the building, the tread flattened, dust in the seams. Entering from the right edge and stopped about ten centimetres short of them: the head of a broom, bristles bent from the sweep, held still. Nothing else in the frame. No people, no faces. The palette is warm but drained — old wood, faded blue rubber, lamp yellow. It should look like an ordinary corner of an ordinary building and it should be very hard to look at.

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu interior at 7:20pm on an ordinary Wednesday, warm lamp, three pairs of shoes in the rack, the fish clock, steam drifting from the bath door, the massage chair humming to itself in the corner
panels.action: An ordinary evening. The building doing the thing it was built to do.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: gruff, head cocked toward the floor
chars.pose: standing at the counter, one hand on a crate

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, counting change
chars.pose: seated at the bandai

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, key rack
panels.action: Somewhere under the floor, the pipes are doing something they did not used to do.

chars.name: ban
chars.expression: unreadable, already leaving
chars.pose: shouldering the empty crate, halfway to the noren

panels.bg: entrance, noren, evening street beyond
panels.action: He does not offer to look at it. He knows better than to offer.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, twenty feet off
chars.pose: crouched at the far end of the bath hall, scrubbing, head down

panels.bg: bath hall from the changing-room doorway, steam, tile grid, one lamp. A single wet footprint on the stone at the near edge of frame.
panels.action: Somebody steps onto wet stone at the other end of the building.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — still turned away, brush not stopping
chars.pose: scrubbing

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, tile, her small in the frame
panels.action: She does not turn round, and she does not stop working, and she is not guessing.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: stopped in the doorway, one shoe half off, delighted and unnerved
chars.pose: balanced on one foot, jersey over his shoulder

panels.bg: changing-room doorway, steam, warm lamp behind him
panels.action: He asks. She has never once answered this and does not start tonight.

dialogue.text: How do you always do that?

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absorbed
chars.pose: wringing a cloth over the bucket

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating, sleeves shoved back
chars.pose: wringing a cloth badly, water going everywhere

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, two buckets, tile
panels.action: Six weeks in. They work like people who have done this a hundred times, because they have.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: wounded, holding up a dripping cloth
chars.pose: arms out, water running down one elbow

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking up
chars.pose: wringing hers out in one movement

panels.bg: bath hall, steam
panels.action: There is, in fact, a wrong way.

dialogue.text: Is there a wrong way to wring a cloth?

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: grinning at the floor, entirely comfortable
chars.pose: going back to work

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: This is the easiest room he has ever been in.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: settled in the massage chair, eyes shut, listening to the building
chars.pose: milk bottle balanced on her stomach

panels.bg: rest area, the working massage chair, warm lamp, fish clock at 8:40
panels.action: The pipes knock again. Fusae-san has been listening to this building for sixty-two years.

chars.name: fusae
chars.expression: eyes still shut, entirely conversational
chars.pose: in the chair

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: wiping the counter, unchanged
chars.pose: cloth moving

panels.bg: rest area and counter, warm lamp
panels.action: A whole man, assembled out of one verb tense and one deadline.

dialogue.text: He'd have had it seen to by Tuesday.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat, cloth still moving, not remotely stopping
chars.pose: wiping

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: She answers with the driest possible fact, and it is a joke, and it is not.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: matter-of-fact
chars.pose: crouched at the boiler, wrench in hand

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: crouched beside her, paying attention properly
chars.pose: hands on his knees

panels.bg: boiler room, pipes, pressure gauge, bare bulb, a wrench-shaped mark worn into the paint beside the nail on the wall
panels.action: She teaches him the maintenance the way she teaches him everything: by doing it once and expecting him to have watched.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: eyebrows up
chars.pose: looking from the gauge to the wrench

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: flat
chars.pose: holding the wrench out to him

panels.bg: boiler room, gauge, bare bulb
panels.action: Not a wrench. The wrench.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: absurdly pleased with himself
chars.pose: having just struck the gauge, watching the needle drop into place

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: already hanging the wrench back on its nail
chars.pose: reaching up

panels.bg: boiler room, needle settling, bare bulb
panels.action: It works. He is enormously proud of a skill that consists of hitting something.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: idle, curious, wiping his hands
chars.pose: reaching for a hardback exercise book on the shelf by the boiler door

panels.bg: shelf beside the boiler door, spare washers, a torch, a stack of receipts, one thick exercise book with a cracked spine
panels.action: There is a book on the shelf that has been there longer than anyone in the room.

panels.bg: an open ruled page: four narrow columns — date, time, water temperature, a small initialled mark. Line after line after line, in a small, neat, slightly slanted hand. Nothing else on the page.
panels.action: A temperature written down every single day, for years, by somebody who thought it mattered.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: half-smiling, thumbing backwards through the block of pages
chars.pose: book open on one forearm

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, the boiler behind him
panels.action: He goes backwards through it the way you flick a thumb across a deck of cards.

panels.bg: the page where it changes. Above the fold: the small neat slanted hand, ending on an ordinary Thursday. Below it, the next line down, no gap and no note: a larger, rounder, unsteadier hand — hers — writing the next day's temperature. And the next. And every line after that, steadying as it goes.
panels.action: No gap. No blank week. The very next day, in a different hand, in the same column.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: the smile going, working it out in about a second
chars.pose: looking down at the page

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, flat screentone
panels.action: He understands exactly what he is holding. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: reaching for lightness because the room has gone heavy — fond, warm, entirely the wrong register
chars.pose: half-laughing, tilting the book

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned at the boiler door
chars.pose: coiling a hose

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, her in the doorway with her back to him
panels.action: Four years of being the one who makes a room easier, firing off at exactly the wrong moment.

dialogue.text: Man kept a diary about hot water.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, absolutely still
chars.pose: hands stopped on the hose, not turning round

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: smile still on his face for one second longer than it should be
chars.pose: book open on his arm

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, pipes, the two of them three metres apart
panels.action: Nothing happens. That is the whole event. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: hearing his own sentence arrive in an empty room — ears hot, eyes down, no way out of this
chars.pose: very still

panels.bg: flat screentone, hard bulb light
panels.action: He has never in his life said a thing that did not get taken. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: no expression he is putting on for anybody
chars.pose: closing the book, setting it back on the shelf square to the edge, picking his cloth back up

panels.bg: shelf by the boiler door, bare bulb
panels.action: He does not apologise. He does not explain. He puts it back the way he found it and goes back to work. That is the apology. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unreadable, working
chars.pose: scrubbing at the far end of the bath hall

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working, head down
chars.pose: scrubbing at the near end

panels.bg: bath hall, steam, the whole tile floor between them
panels.action: They work. It is not the comfortable silence from earlier and both of them know it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouth opening on something
chars.pose: brush stopped

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: He has a sentence that would fix it. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: mouth closing again
chars.pose: brush moving again

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: He does not use it. Twenty minutes of this. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not looking, hand out behind her
chars.pose: reaching sideways for the bucket without turning her head

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, bucket already in frame beside her
panels.action: She reaches for the bucket the way she reaches for it every night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: hand stopping on the rim, eyes going to it
chars.pose: fingers on a full bucket

panels.bg: the bucket, filled to the line, steam coming off it, wet tile
panels.action: It is full. It has been full for a while. He filled it at some point without saying so. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: working steadily, head down
chars.pose: sweeping the changing-room floorboards toward the counter

panels.bg: changing room, floorboards, stacked baskets, the bandai counter ahead of him, warm lamp
panels.action: Later. The last job of the night, done in the direction it is always done in.

panels.bg: the broom head stopped ten centimetres short of a pair of worn blue sandals, squared up neatly against the base of the counter, dust in the seams
panels.action: They are in the way. They have been in the way of this sweep every night for fourteen months. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: ordinary, practical, offering her the easiest possible exit
chars.pose: broom upright, glancing over his shoulder toward the counter

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: at the far side of the room with the ledger, half-turned
chars.pose: pen in hand

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, wide floor between them
panels.action: The most boring question available. All she has to do is say yes.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: three-quarters turned away, face mostly out of frame, entirely level
chars.pose: standing still, ledger closed against her leg

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, the counter behind her
panels.action: She does not take it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: nothing arriving on his face — no sympathy arranged, no joke loaded
chars.pose: hands still on the broom

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, flat screentone
panels.action: He does not reach for comfort and he does not reach for a bit. He already tried that tonight. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: plain, practical, asking to be given a job
chars.pose: broom lowered, looking at the sandals rather than at her

panels.bg: changing room, floorboards, warm lamp
panels.action: The only language this building has ever taught him: ask what the task is.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back fully turned now
chars.pose: standing at the counter, both hands flat on it

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, the long empty room, the fish clock at 11:26
panels.action: A very long beat. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — back turned, already moving again
chars.pose: opening the ledger, picking the pen back up

panels.bg: counter, warm lamp, ledger open
panels.action: She hands him the rota. She has never told anybody it exists.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: concentrating on getting it exactly right
chars.pose: crouched, setting the broom aside, squaring the sandals back against the counter with both hands

panels.bg: floorboards, counter base, warm lamp
panels.action: He puts them back exactly where they were, and then adjusts one of them a centimetre. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: head coming up
chars.pose: still crouched

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: pen stopping
chars.pose: at the counter

panels.bg: changing room, warm lamp, floorboards — and under the boards, the sound
panels.action: The pipes go again, and this time they do not stop.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: unreadable, businesslike
chars.pose: down the boiler-room steps, reaching for the wrench on its nail

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: following, stopping at the top of the steps
chars.pose: one hand on the door frame

panels.bg: boiler room from the steps, pipes, bare bulb, the pressure gauge
panels.action: She goes down. He gets as far as the doorway and no further.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand and wrench only
chars.pose: the wrench striking the gauge housing, one clean practised blow

panels.bg: the pressure gauge, glass, the needle sitting high and wrong. Bare bulb light.
panels.action: Once. The way he did it. The needle does not move.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand and wrench only
chars.pose: the wrench striking the gauge housing again, identical

panels.bg: ART NOTE: compose this panel identically to the previous one — same crop, same angle, same distance. The only difference is the needle, which has still not moved.
panels.action: Twice.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: n/a — hand and wrench only
chars.pose: the wrench striking the gauge housing again, identical

panels.bg: ART NOTE: compose identically to the previous two panels a third time. Needle unmoved. Three identical frames in a row.
panels.action: Three times. Her hands are never wrong.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absolutely nothing. her face holds. that is the point.
chars.pose: wrench raised for a fourth, arm perfectly steady

panels.bg: boiler room, bare bulb, gauge out of focus
panels.action: Her face does none of the work. Silent.

panels.bg: the gauge, the needle finally dropping into the green, the wrench edge just leaving the frame
panels.action: The fourth one does it.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: having watched all of it, saying none of it
chars.pose: at the top of the steps, hand still on the door frame, not coming down

panels.bg: boiler-room steps, bare bulb below, warm lamp above
panels.action: He does not go down and he does not touch her and he does not ask if she is all right. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: back turned, ordinary
chars.pose: picking up the full bucket from the bottom of the steps and carrying it away toward the drain

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — small, at the gauge, alone in the frame
chars.pose: hanging the wrench back on its nail

panels.bg: boiler room and the steps up, bare bulb, the mark worn into the paint beside the nail
panels.action: He takes the heavy thing and leaves her the room. Silent.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: unremarkable, competent
chars.pose: unhooking the noren from outside and folding it correctly, in three movements, without looking at his hands

panels.bg: Kotobuki-yu entrance at 11:41pm, sign off, cold clear night
panels.action: He folds it the way she folds it. Nobody comments on that any more.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: half-lidded, writing
chars.pose: seated at the counter entering the night's temperature in the exercise book

panels.bg: bandai counter, warm lamp, the cash tray, and pushed half under it a stiff city-office envelope, unopened, exactly where it was in chapter one
panels.action: The book goes back on the shelf every night. So does everything else.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: not visible — reaching up
chars.pose: killing the entrance sign

panels.bg: empty changing room, baskets stacked, fish clock at 11:44, the sandals squared up at the base of the counter
panels.action: Closing. Same as every night.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: absorbed, ordinary
chars.pose: crouched, scrubbing the grout line

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: absorbed, ordinary
chars.pose: crouched two metres off, scrubbing his own patch, angle correct

panels.bg: bath hall after closing, steam, tile grid, one lamp, the mural
panels.action: And then they do the floor, because the floor still needs doing.

chars.name: itsuki
chars.expression: not looking up, entirely casual, as if confirming a shift pattern
chars.pose: scrubbing

panels.bg: wet tile, steam
panels.action: He does not ask whether he can. He asks which day it is.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: no reaction at all, brush not stopping
chars.pose: scrubbing, head down

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, mural behind
panels.action: Nothing. Six or seven seconds of nothing. Silent.

chars.name: nagi
chars.expression: face holding, entirely level, eyes on the grout
chars.pose: still scrubbing

panels.bg: wet tile, steam, close
panels.action: She accepts all of it without acknowledging any of it, and issues a supply requisition. Final panel, spoken.
